facts.value: Acts as a consumptive release gate shared by grounded and aerial copied-Luigi SpecialN. With throw-B0 clear, it performs no release work. With throw-B0 set, it clears that flag before computing the left-hand position, calling the void item constructor `it_802C01AC` for `It_Kind_Kirby_LuigiFire`, and requesting effect `0x4B1`. Each consumed event produces one such request sequence, not a guaranteed successfully created projectile-and-effect pair: the constructor internally permits item allocation failure, and the effect request still follows. Entries install this callback and collision continuations restore it; restoring the callback does not itself raise a new throw-B0 event.
facts.rationale: Corrects the existing guarantee of one emitted projectile-and-effect pair per event while preserving supported event-consumption and callback-lifecycle knowledge. The nullable value belongs to the constructor's internal allocation, not its void return type.

evidence.why: Shows entry installation, collision restoration, release guard, item call and subsequent effect request.
Throw-B0 is cleared before the guarded release body executes.
The constructor returns void and initializes the projectile only when its internal allocation returns non-NULL.
